property_summary: For every actor and any sequence of deposit amounts, a second Put must add to the existing balance (balance equals the sum of all deposits); the mutant overwrites the balance so it equals only the last deposit, violating the rule for any input with two nonzero deposits.
change_summary: Replace `acc.balance += msg.value;` with `acc.balance = msg.value;` so the deposit overwrites rather than accumulates the balance.
